input.encoding: Each node is [value, left child index, right child index]; -1 means absent. The root index and one-based rank k are passed separately.
input.root_index: The root may be at any node-table index.
input.tree_requirement: A valid nonempty rooted binary search tree with unique node values and every node reachable exactly once.
input.k_range: 1 through the number of nodes, inclusive.
input.result: Value at the one-based kth position in inorder traversal.
